author: Jordan Liles
claim_reviewed: Oscar-winning actor Denzel Washington said, "I've worked with a lot of people in my life, and I've never met anyone braver, smarter, or who cares more about America than Donald Trump. He's a great friend and an even better president. I'm proud to be a steadfast supporter, and I'll never apologize for it. God Bless America and our president."
title: Did Denzel Washington say he's 'never met anyone braver, smarter' than Trump?
